question: Should the named LiteLLM onboarding choice grow an interactive proxy base-URL and model-discovery setup, or should remote LiteLLM users be routed to Custom Provider?
rationale: Both paths are technically plausible, but the choice affects provider-owned onboarding UX, endpoint probing, docs, and the boundary between bundled provider setup and generic custom endpoints.

options.title: Add LiteLLM URL Prompt
options.body: Have litellm-api-key ask for or confirm the proxy base URL before model selection while preserving non-interactive --custom-base-url behavior.

options.title: Route To Custom Provider
options.body: Keep LiteLLM as localhost/default-model setup and update prompts/docs so remote LiteLLM proxies use Custom Provider.

options.title: Defer For Catalog Policy
options.body: Pause this until maintainers settle the broader provider-plugin model-discovery contract.

recommendation.title: Add LiteLLM URL Prompt
recommendation.body: Have litellm-api-key ask for or confirm the proxy base URL before model selection while preserving non-interactive --custom-base-url behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the recent LiteLLM pluginization and custom-base-url behavior that shape this decision.
